name: imf_get_weo_data
description:
World Economic Outlook (WEO) annual series for one country, including IMF projections, by a friendly indicator name or a WEO code, from the IMF SDMX JSON data service (dataservices.imf.org, no API key).
Returns: database, country_code, indicator_code, frequency, data (period, value) and count; a note when the series is empty (frequency always A).
Inputs (* required): country_code* (ISO 2-letter); indicator (gdp_growth, gdp_per_capita, inflation_avg, inflation_eop, unemployment, current_account, fiscal_balance, public_debt, exports_volume, imports_volume, population) or indicator_code (WEO code such as NGDP_RPCH, wins over indicator); one of the two is needed; start_year and end_year (1950-2030; omit both for the full history).
For monthly or quarterly financial series use imf_get_ifs_data; for a five-indicator snapshot imf_get_country_profile.
Example: {"country_code": "IN", "indicator": "gdp_growth", "start_year": 2018, "end_year": 2028}

start_year.description: First year, YYYY; if only end_year is given this defaults to 1950

end_year.description: Last year, YYYY; if only start_year is given this defaults to the current year; omit both for the full history

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: World Economic Outlook provides macroeconomic indicators and forecasts from the IMF.
